study_identification_part.si_4_title: Rightward brain structural asymmetry in young children with autism

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: The study used Gaussian process regression (GPR) implemented via the Predictive Clinical Neuroscience (PCN) toolkit to generate individualized normative models of GMV asymmetry development. The GPR models were trained on 247 typically developing children with 5-fold cross-validation to avoid overfitting and obtain optimal parameters.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: we calculated the normative models of development using the Predictive Clinical Neuroscience toolkit [46] with the Gaussian process regression (GPR) method, which can provide point estimates as well as coherent measures of predictive confidence.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: Geng2025.pdf.md: Methods / Statistical and normative modelling analysis

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: The response variable was the laterality index of gray matter volume (GMV) calculated for each brain region using the Desikan-Killiany template (34 regions). The laterality index was computed as (GMVleft - GMVright) / ((GMVleft + GMVright) / 2), ranging from -2 to 2. This represents GMV asymmetry rather than raw GMV values.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Finally, the laterality index in each region for every subject was calculated as GMVleft − GMVright / (GMVleft + GMVright) / 2, which is a commonly used formula for values with a range from -2 to 2.
nm2_2_response_variable.location: Geng2025.pdf.md: Methods / MRI data acquisition, quality control and processing

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age and sex were used as covariates in the normative model. The models were trained on typically developing children aged 1-7 years, and individual deviations (Z-scores) were calculated for patient groups using their GMV asymmetry metrics along with these covariates.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: Specifically, GPR models of GMV asymmetry for each ROI were trained based on 247 TDs with age and sex as covariates.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.location: Geng2025.pdf.md: Methods / Statistical and normative modelling analysis
